candidate: dense visited bitmap with bounded allocation and sparse fallback
limitations: One before and one after campaign on the same shared Windows host; warm caches, not alternating isolated trials.
Query batches are 100 sequential Rust queries before saving and after loading the snapshot; not per-query latency percentiles.
Synthetic input generated by ann_restart_bench; no zvec rerun and no cross-engine superiority claim.
Graph topology equivalence is separately regression-tested against a baseline fingerprint; these snapshot checks compare each build with its own reopen/rebuild.
No measurements at 100k x 768, on other operating systems, or above the sparse-fallback threshold.
